COLDWAR_SWE_facility_draft_available = {
	COLDWAR_SWE_manufacturing_buyer_allowed = yes
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_trade_state_selected
	var:COLDWAR_SWE_trade_state = { is_owned_by = ROOT is_controlled_by = ROOT }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_facility_application_open }
	OR = { AND = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_manufacturing_product = 101 } check_variable = { global.build_cost_array^1 > 0 } SWE = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_bankrupt } } } AND = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_manufacturing_product = 102 } check_variable = { global.build_cost_array^1 > 0 } SWE = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_asea_bankrupt } } } AND = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_manufacturing_product = 103 } check_variable = { global.build_cost_array^1 > 0 } SWE = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ericsson_bankrupt } } } AND = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_manufacturing_product = 104 } check_variable = { global.build_cost_array^3 > 0 } SWE = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_kockums_bankrupt } } } }
}
